visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright bedroom where a woman with long dark hair is lying face down in a bed with white linens and a large tufted headboard. A grey and white long-haired cat sits at the foot of the bed. The woman stretches her arms upward as natural light filters through sheer curtains in the background. (2) In a bathroom setting, the woman wears a black robe and a white headband, brushing her teeth with an electric toothbrush in front of a mirror. (3) She steps onto a white InBody scale which displays a weight of 50.2 kg. (4) In the kitchen area, she drinks milk directly from a carton and then pours bottled water into an automated cat water fountain. (5) A yellow bunny-shaped cake is shown on a table; she uses a lighter to ignite a single pink candle. She sits alone in a pink gaming chair eating a piece of the cake and drinking from a mug. (6) The woman performs household chores, including vacuuming the white living room floor with a cordless vacuum and putting a grey comforter into a top-loading washing machine on a balcony. (7) She is seen working at a desk with two computer monitors and pink peripherals. Later, she brushes her long hair and applies makeup at a vanity. (8) She gets dressed in a light blue shirt, selects a black quilted handbag from a glass display case, and heads out. (9) She sits in a brightly lit retail space eating a purple food item. (10) The final scene takes place at a beach under an overcast sky. She runs towards the ocean waves, sits in a black folding chair on the sand, and raises her arms toward the horizon as the tide comes in. Yellow and white Chinese text overlays appear periodically.
